[SWS_DM_01310] Realization of UDS service RequestFileTransfer (0x38)
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04135
⌈
The
Diagnostic Server instance
shall implement the UDS service Request-
FileTransfer (0x38) according to ISO 14229-1[1]. Besides the NRC checking according
to [SWS_DM_00101] and [SWS_DM_00103] the DM does no further service valida-
tion. All other NRC checks required by ISO 14229-1[1] for UDS service RequestFile-
Transfer have to be implemented in the adaptive application.
⌋
